diagnosis: Invasive ductal carcinoma NST, grade 2, 1.8 cm, margins negative.
biology: ER-positive, PR-positive, HER2-negative (IHC 1+). Trastuzumab would only be considered if HER2 were positive, which it is not.
genomic_risk: Recurrence score 14 is low risk, so chemotherapy offers no benefit.
chemotherapy_decision: Chemotherapy is not recommended. It would only be considered if the recurrence score were high or nodes were involved.
endocrine_therapy: Aromatase inhibitor for 5 years, possibly extended to 10 years.
radiotherapy: Adjuvant whole-breast radiotherapy is recommended; omission would only be discussed if she were over 70.
